description: An eight-input gate whose function you choose with three logic inputs: the eight inputs are taken as two groups of four, combined within each group and then combined again with each other.

inputs.text: One of the four inputs in the first group. The group is ORed together for the first four functions and ANDed together for the last four.
One of the four inputs in the second group. The group is ORed together for the first four functions and ANDed together for the last four.
Joins the final combination, so another CD4048 output patched here widens the gate. It is ORed in for the NOR, OR, AND/NOR and AND/OR functions and inverted then ANDed in for the other four.
The highest of the three function inputs, worth four when the three are read as a binary number.
The middle of the three function inputs, worth two when the three are read as a binary number.
The lowest of the three function inputs, worth one when the three are read as a binary number.

outputs.text: 10V while the selected function is satisfied, 0V while it is not.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
KA, KB and KC read as a binary number pick the function from the list printed on the panel, in the order NOR, OR, OR/AND, OR/NAND, AND, NAND, AND/NOR, AND/OR. Unpatched, it is NOR.
